title: Elevator
prompt: a three-floor traction elevator with the shaft cut open: press a floor button, the doors close, the car rises on its ropes while the counterweight falls, doors open; see-through shows the motor and sheave in the machine room, ropes, counterweight, guide rails, buffers and safety brake
blurb: Send the car between three floors and watch the drive sheave haul it up on its ropes while the counterweight drops, then overspeed it and see the governor trip the safety gear onto the rails.
